C. 26,000. Global Terrorism Database figures for 2017 put worldwide terrorism deaths a bit over 26,000, and counts that exclude perpetrators still land near 19,000, so 26,000 is the only option in the right range. A single 2017 attack, the Mogadishu truck bombing, killed several hundred people, which rules out 260 and 2,600.
CONFIDENCE: 88
